title: Accessibility-visible failure
intendedUserGoal: Understand verification status and act on visible account requirements.

strongFindings.rootCause: Important text is visually soft against the background.
Status is communicated primarily through colour.
The small circular action may be difficult to recognise and activate.

rootCauseObservations: Visible readability and recognisable state communication are the primary concerns.
mergeGuidance: Keep contrast, colour-only state, and target size separate when they affect different user needs.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not claim full WCAG failure unless measured evidence is present.
